answer: Unique task ledger assigns each new identity one reserved, independently checked task before payout. The ledger compares results against a seeded echo of prior work and rejects duplicates. Each clone pays separate hardware attestation and a challenge delay exceeding its capped orchard of first-period rewards. A failed challenge locks credits and queue position, adding a spiral of delay; compute, attestation, and lost position make the marginal clone strictly negative-EV.
